description: This file defines the Termynal class, a widget for animated terminal-like displays using async/await, with methods for initialization, line typing, progress bars, and controls like restart and fast-forward.

classes.name: Termynal
classes.description: A class for creating animated terminal window widgets with customizable options and controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Termynal widget with container and options.

methods.name: loadLines
methods.description: Loads and prepares all terminal lines for animation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget, clears container, and starts animation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the animation sequence, rendering lines based on data attributes.

methods.name: lineDataToElements
methods.description: Converts line data objects into DOM elements.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Generates attribute string from line data object.
